crossRefs.note: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
Their prince will be one of them, and their ruler will proceed from among them. I will cause him to draw near, and he…
let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having…
Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the…
May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry…
David spoke to Yahweh when he saw the angel who struck the people, and said, “Behold, I have sinned, and I have done…
Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath?…
May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
translations.bsb: Abraham stepped forward and said, “Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
translations.kjv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
translations.asv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou consume the righteous with the wicked?
